description: Overview PitchCraft 3.0 is a flagship ideathon organized as part of IEEE Days 2026. It provides a platform for students to develop innovative and feasible solutions to real-world problems and present their ideas before a judging panel. The event focuses on problem-solving, originality, feasibility, implementation, and impact. Shortlisted Teams Announcement: 21st October 2026, 12:00 Noon WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/Hhagq0zSN2JCktgN4Xrcnc?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4 Guidelines: Open to all students from any college/university. Team size: 2–4 members . Only registered team members will be allowed to present. Registration is compulsory through Unstop . No on-spot registration is allowed. Names must be entered exactly as per College ID. The PPT must include: Team Name Selected Problem Statement Problem Explanation Proposed Solution Implementation Approach Feasibility Expected Impact All work must be original. Plagiarism will result in disqualification. Shortlisted Teams will be declared on the whatsApp group and the registered email of the leader. Registration fees of 100rs will be collected for offline campus round after shortlisting in online ppt round. For further details join the whatsapp group. Rules: Shortlisted teams must report 30 minutes prior at the venue. Teams must bring their own laptop and necessary accessories such as chargers and adapters. All team members must carry valid College ID cards. No substitutions or extra entries are allowed. Delay may lead to cancellation of the presentation slot. Participants must respect the allotted time limits. Any misconduct may lead to disqualification. Judges' decision will be final and binding.
organiser: Guru Tegh Bahadur 4th Centenary Engineering College, Delhi

Overview

PitchCraft 3.0 is a flagship ideathon organized as part of IEEE Days 2026. It provides a platform for students to develop innovative and feasible solutions to real-world problems and present their ideas before a judging panel. The event focuses on problem-solving, originality, feasibility, implementation, and impact.

Shortlisted Teams Announcement: 21st October 2026, 12:00 Noon

WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/Hhagq0zSN2JCktgN4Xrcnc?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Guidelines:

  • Open to all students from any college/university.
  • Team size: 2–4 members.
  • Only registered team members will be allowed to present.
  • Registration is compulsory through Unstop. No on-spot registration is allowed.
  • Names must be entered exactly as per College ID.
  • The PPT must include:
    • Team Name
    • Selected Problem Statement
    • Problem Explanation
    • Proposed Solution
    • Implementation Approach
    • Feasibility
    • Expected Impact
  • All work must be original. Plagiarism will result in disqualification.
  • Shortlisted Teams will be declared on the whatsApp group and the registered email of the leader.
  • Registration fees of 100rs will be collected for offline campus round after shortlisting in online ppt round.
  • For further details join the whatsapp group.

Rules:

  • Shortlisted teams must report 30 minutes prior at the venue.
  • Teams must bring their own laptop and necessary accessories such as chargers and adapters.
  • All team members must carry valid College ID cards.
  • No substitutions or extra entries are allowed.
  • Delay may lead to cancellation of the presentation slot.
  • Participants must respect the allotted time limits.
  • Any misconduct may lead to disqualification.
  • Judges' decision will be final and binding.
